title: Release note entry: Dedicated autoscaling bounds (min/max) + predictive mode (preview)
author: Connor O'Brien
pr_body:
Summary: Adds an internal release note + changelog entry for the Dedicated autoscaling bounds feature (customer-configurable min/max) and predictive scaling mode (preview) for select accounts. This is intended for the GA go/no-go thread + internal enablement, and links to the customer-facing docs PR separately.

Customer impact: Dedicated customers can optionally set hard min/max replica bounds per deployment to control baseline capacity and spend ceilings. Predictive mode can pre-scale based on forecasted demand, but reactive signals still take precedence for safety; all decisions respect bounds.

Enablement / rollout notes: Feature remains opt-in behind account/deployment scoped flags. Existing deployments are unchanged until enabled. Canary first in us-east-1, then expand to pilot accounts. Includes explicit note on shortage behavior (min may be unmet during region capacity constraints; surfaced as degraded and alerted).

Operational notes: Calls out new dashboards/alerts for max-bound saturation and bounded-desired vs requested-desired. Mentions audit events for policy changes and autoscaler decisions for enterprise compliance.

Links: PM epic PM-1842; implementation PRs include min/max clamp + metrics + audit events; dashboards and alert rules in observability-pack; customer-facing docs in redwood-docs.

Release note text added is internal-only and written to be copied into the customer comms / launch brief if needed.
commits: chore(release-notes): add Dedicated autoscaling bounds entry
docs(changelog): clarify enablement + preview status for predictive mode
docs: link runbook + dashboards for bounded scaling
ci_checks: Buildkite: redwood-tests (passed); Lint (passed); Docs link check (passed)
review_conversation:
Lauren Bishop (Product): Can we avoid calling predictive mode GA here? It’s still pilot/preview and should be framed as optional + guarded. Also add a one-liner about precedence (reactive overrides predictions) but always within bounds.

Connor O'Brien (Author): Updated wording to “preview” + added explicit precedence sentence in both the release note and changelog.

Rafael Mendes (SRE): Please include the shortage caveat: min bound may not be met if the region is constrained, and we surface degraded state + page on sustained unmet-min. Also link the troubleshooting runbook.

Connor O'Brien (Author): Added shortage note + linked runbook and dashboard. Also added a short section under “Operational notes”.

Kira Thompson (Docs): Minor: use consistent term “replicas” vs “GPUs” (release note should say replicas; contract language can refer to GPU pools). Also don’t promise Terraform support in this note; it’s landing shortly but not guaranteed same day.

Connor O'Brien (Author): Standardized on “replicas” and removed Terraform mention from the internal note (kept as follow-up item in PM-1842).

Allison Grant (Observability): Added dashboard link is good; please mention the primary bound-hit metric name so folks can search quickly.

Connor O'Brien (Author): Added metric identifiers in parentheses (requested_desired, bounded_desired, bound_hit_total) without embedding full metric naming doc.

Approvals: Lauren Bishop approved; Rafael Mendes approved; Kira Thompson approved; Allison Grant approved.
release_notes: Dedicated: Add customer-configurable autoscaling bounds (min/max replicas) per deployment (opt-in).
Dedicated: Predictive autoscaling mode (preview) can pre-scale for known ramps; reactive signals still protect SLOs; bounds always enforced.
Ops: New dashboards/alerts for max-bound saturation, bounded desired vs requested desired, and prediction error visibility.
Compliance: Audit events for scaling policy changes and autoscaler decisions (for enterprise Dedicated accounts).
